storage.activation_payload_scope: Individual tensor payload / summed traffic; not peak resident buffer. Shapes from actual Linear in_features; prefill L and one-token decode.

dynamic_a.rule: per current token/point, reduce only hidden components; FP32 scale, constant zero_point=0
dynamic_a.hardware_work: max reduction, scale/reciprocal, quantize; buffer/latency/scale representation require later integer/RTL contract

storage.scope: logical packed payload plus FP32 scales/int32 explicit static zero-points; shared weight once; no alignment, buffers, packing implementation or FPGA costs

smoothquant_metadata.scope: Per-input-feature scale consumed by runtime activation x/s; required unless equivalent scaling is fused into the datapath. Not an A activation payload.
